name: Minas Tirith
note: Fan work from Tolkien, whose work belongs to the Tolkien Estate; nothing from any book, film or game is used. The city, the Pelennor and Mindolluin are generated by tools/make-minastirith.py from the published description: seven walls each a hundred feet above the last, a keel of rock through them carrying the Citadel, and gates that alternate round it so no gate is under the one before. Positions are [lat, lon] against an origin on the Citadel.
attribution: Minas Tirith is fan work: the city generated by tools/make-minastirith.py. Tolkien's world belongs to the Tolkien Estate. No assets used.

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

landmarks.name: The White Tower
landmarks.info: Fifty fathoms of white stone on the Citadel, and the Citadel is seven hundred feet over the Pelennor, so the standard at its top stands a thousand feet above the fields. The banner is black, and there is no king to put a white tree on it.

landmarks.name: The Rock
landmarks.info: A shoulder of Mindolluin that comes out through the middle of the city and stands over the Citadel itself, so the seven circles are horseshoes rather than rings. Its east end stops dead in mid-air above the first circle, and the road up goes through it twice.

landmarks.name: The Court of the Fountain
landmarks.info: The high court behind the Tower: a sward, a fountain, and the White Tree that died and was left standing because no one would cut it down.

landmarks.name: The Great Gate
landmarks.info: The only way in. Steel and adamant in a black wall, facing east down the Causeway towards Osgiliath, and the one gate in the seven that anything larger than a cart ever came through.

landmarks.name: Mount Mindolluin
landmarks.info: The city is built against its eastern skirt, and the Hallows are cut into the rock behind the Citadel.

landmarks.name: The Causeway Forts
landmarks.info: Where the road from Osgiliath comes through the Rammas Echor, the wall round the townlands.

landmarks.name: The Harlond
landmarks.info: The quays on the Anduin, downstream of the city, where anything that comes by water is landed.

landmarks.name: Osgiliath
landmarks.info: The old capital, astride the river and in ruins on both banks. The bridge went long ago.

hosts._: the siege: hosts coming up the roads from Osgiliath and the south, and the Nazgul over them

life._: banners on every circle, cooking smoke, market stalls and fire on the walls after dark
